vopros: Who does AI search optimization for small businesses in the US, and what does it cost?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Small businesses can hire **SEO agencies, specialist AEO/GEO firms, or independent consultants**. You’ll see the service described as **AI search optimization**, **AEO** (answer engine optimization), **GEO** (generative engine optimization), or **AI SEO**. It aims to improve a business’s chances of being mentioned or cited in answers from tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. It overlaps heavily with traditional SEO; no provider can guarantee placement in AI answers.

### What it tends to cost in the US

| Option | Typical cost | Usually suited to |
|---|---:|---|
| DIY visibility tools | About **$50–$300/month** | Owners who can do the research and optimization themselves |
| Freelancer or consultant | About **$500–$1,500/month** | Targeted help, audits, or a limited ongoing scope |
| Small-business agency package | Roughly **$1,000–$5,000/month** | Ongoing strategy and implementation; many local businesses will land toward the lower end |
| One-time audit or project | Often **$1,500–$5,000** | A defined review, roadmap, or initial setup |

Published prices vary widely. One 2026 pricing survey reported a **$750 median entry price** among agency AI SEO packages with listed prices, while other agency guides put small-business programs more commonly around **$1,000–$5,000 monthly**. Many agencies don’t publish rates, so treat these as ballparks and compare actual deliverables. [Survey summary](https://www.cincinnati.com/press-release/story/130999/ai-seo-costs-small-businesses-20-more-at-most-agencies-seotal-research-finds/) · [Pricing guide](https://www.searchbloom.com/strategy/best-ai-seo-agency-companies-services-usa/)

### Who to look at

Rather than assume one provider is best, get quotes from:
- **Your current SEO or local marketing agency**—ask whether they include AI-search work or offer it as an add-on.
- **A specialist AEO/GEO agency**—ask for examples relevant to your industry and local market.
- **A freelance SEO/AEO consultant**—often a more affordable way to get an audit or implement a focused plan.

Before signing, ask what the fee covers: for example, local listings and business details, technical fixes and structured data, content updates, monitoring of AI mentions or citations, reporting, and the number of platforms covered. Confirm any setup fee, minimum contract, and whether content production costs extra.
